item.title: Some Thoughts on the Words of our Beloved Founder Acarya
item.description: Praghosa Prabhu reflects on the universal role of the guru in Krishna consciousness, emphasizing that the soul is not defined by bodily distinctions such as gender. Citing multiple statements from Srila Prabhupada, he argues that spiritual qualification—not gender—is the true criterion for becoming a guru. item.title: Lord Nityananda Delivers the Thieves
item.description: By Mohini Radha Devi Dasi A Greedy Gang of Thieves: Srila Vrindavana Dasa Thakura has narrated this astonishing pastime in Chaitanya-bhagavata (Antya-khanda 5.527–706). item.title: The appearance day of Lord Nityananda
item.description: By Bhakti Vigna Vinasa Narasimha Swami So today the auspicious day of the appearance day of Lord Nityananda.
